title: Contract cost estimator and SQ-driven pricing exceptions workflow
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Problem statement: Enterprise deals frequently include redlined MSA/DPA terms that change indemnity and liability bands. Sales and Legal currently estimate commercial impact manually, which slows approvals and causes inconsistent pricing concessions. Security questionnaires (SQs) sometimes surface controls gaps that should influence liability bands and insurance clauses, but the handoff between Security, Legal, and Sales is ad hoc.

Goal: Build a lightweight Contract Cost Estimator (CCE) surfaced in the sales contract review UI that: (1) maps common redline categories to estimated price or discount impact, (2) incorporates SQ-derived controls gaps as automatic flags that adjust recommended concession bands, and (3) drives a structured exception workflow with clear approval gates and SLAs for Legal and Security review.

Scope: Phase 1 (this ticket) covers mapping 12 high-frequency redline clauses (indemnity cap, IP indemnity, data breach liability, audit frequency, subprocessor flow-down) to dollar/discount estimates based on historical concessions and pricing experiments, plus an SQ integration that adds a +/– adjustment factor based on three SQ control outcomes (critical gap, mitigated, compliant). Not included: full downstream billing automation or contract signature flow.

Why now: Reducing the time-to-approve for enterprise deals will increase win rates for larger customers and reduce deal desk load. We also need telemetry to quantify how much revenue is forgone to blanket conservative approvals.

Users: Sales Triage/Solutions Engineers, Legal reviewers, Security reviewers, Revenue Ops for reporting.
acceptance_criteria: CCE UI appears in Contract Review page and shows a line-itemized estimate for selected redline clauses
SQ score integration shows adjustment flags and delta to the estimate when SQ outcome selected
Approval workflow creates a triage task for Legal when estimated concession exceeds configurable threshold
All estimator inputs and outputs are logged to telemetry with tags: deal_id, model_version, selected_clauses
Experiment toggle available to run estimator in "simulate" mode (no enforced gates) for 30-day A/B test
success_metrics: Reduce average contract review time from 6 business days to <=3 business days for deals flagged by estimator
Increase on-time Legal approvals by 30% for deals with automated triage
Collect at least 500 estimator-run events with associated outcome labels (approved/rejected/negotiated) in first 60 days
Measure correlation between SQ 'critical gap' flag and final concession size to validate adjustment factor (>0.3 effect size expected)
tasks: PM: finalize clause-to-cost mapping and governance matrix (owner: Priya)
Design: mock CCE UI + simulate mode UX and Legal approval modal (owner: Sofia Martinez)
Eng (Frontend): implement CCE UI components and experiment toggle (owner: ENG-3478)
Eng (Backend): build estimator API, telemetry hooks, and feature flag gating (owner: ENG-4120)
Security: define SQ outcome canonicalization and mapping to adjustment factors (owner: Marcus Liu)
Legal: review and approve default mapping, thresholds, and escalation rules (owner: Ava Rodriguez)
Analytics: create contract review dashboard and experiment tracking (owner: Maia Patel)
risks: Estimator may bias Legal to over-rely on numerical outputs; must include clear caveat language
Historical concession data is noisy; mapping may need continued calibration to avoid pricing erosion
SQ outcomes are partially subjective across reviewers; canonicalization work is required to avoid false positives
Integration with sales tooling may leak sensitive customer data if telemetry tagging is misconfigured
open_questions: What is the initial default concession conversion rate for 'indemnity cap reduction' (percentage vs absolute dollars)?
Who owns periodic calibration of mapping: Legal or Product? Suggested: product with Legal review every quarter.
Should we allow Sales to override estimator recommendations with required justification (text) before routing?
What SLA should Legal have for auto-triaged requests? Proposal: 48 business hours for P0 concessions, 5 business days for P1
updates: 2026-01-12 — Kickoff: Reviewed historical concessions dataset with Revenue Ops; found ~2,400 records from last 18 months. Initial data quality issues flagged (missing deal size for ~12%).

2026-01-20 — Design review: Sofia presented two mock flows (inline estimator vs side panel). PM prefers inline because it surfaces impact during clause redlining. Legal asked for persistent 'explainability' view.

2026-01-28 — Security sync: Marcus proposed 3-tier SQ canonicalization (compliant / mitigated / critical gap). Adjustment multipliers proposed: 0%, +10%, +35% concession uplift respectively; agreed as temporary defaults.
2026-02-02 — Eng scoping: ENG-3478 and ENG-4120 timeboxed initial API + UI implementation to two sprints. Backend needs clearer schema for clause taxonomy (action: Priya to finalize).

2026-02-08 — PM decision: Move forward with 'simulate' experiment for the first 30 days post-launch. Legal signed off on mapping except for IP indemnity which requires the indemnity playbook update. Added follow-up task for Legal (due 2026-02-22).
